definition.description: Input for updating the static hosts configured on a site.

host.description:
Replaces all static hosts configured on the site with the provided host configurations.
Cannot be used together with `hostToAdd` or `hostToRemove`.
host.name: host

ip.description: IP address assigned to the static host.
ip.name: ip

macAddress.description: MAC address of the static host.
macAddress.name: macAddress

hostToAdd.description:
Adds new static hosts to the existing site configuration.
Cannot be used together with `host`.
hostToAdd.name: hostToAdd

hostToRemove.description:
Removes static hosts from the existing site configuration.
Cannot be used together with `host`.
hostToRemove.name: hostToRemove

hostId.description: Unique identifier of the static host.
hostId.name: hostId

site.description: Information about the site whose static hosts are being updated.
site.name: site

definition.name: UpdateSiteStaticHostsInput

updateSiteStaticHosts.description: Bulk update static hosts by replacing the full collection or applying add/remove deltas.
updateSiteStaticHosts.name: updateSiteStaticHosts
